cost.deployment_cost_admission: Not reached on rank failure; diagnostic eigensolves are offline and are not hidden inside a candidate.

cross_lane_constraints_consumed.analytic: complete q2 covariance; q3-q5 collision sectors; mixed q6/q7/q9; rank<=13; 99% completeness and 70% relevance; immediate action is a necessary block of any nonlinear suffix
cross_lane_constraints_consumed.kerdock: N=65536 remains viable with recursive Winograd; old scalar h2:h7 reset is forgotten after the last reset, so persistent Duhamel/action queries are required

decision.marginal_all_column_escape: Informational only: Kerdock paths already expose all 1024 scalar column actions, so marginal rank failure does not close that cheap sidecar.
decision.meaning: The saved U13 is the optimal unconstrained endpoint basis. Failure is an upper-bound failure for every <=13 common-V or factorized-query spelling.

operator.basis_is_not_hidden_V: U13 permits arbitrary tensor queries and is strictly more favorable than a hidden V or factor tuples. A hidden V is emitted only after U13 passes.
operator.basis_semantics: OPTIMAL_ENDPOINT_BASIS_R13.npy axes are network, source layer, block, descending basis vector, immediate output coordinate
operator.definition: immediate h_l cumulant/covariance innovation -> scored mean h_(l+1), with covariance-resummed scalar Hermite coefficients
operator.partition_multinomial_constants: suppressed per sector because their positive square is a common Gram scale and cancels retained-energy ratios and eigenvectors

scope.panel_selection: observer_fit role ranks floor(j*687/2), j=0,1,2; fixed stratification independent of weights, targets, residuals, and scores
